idea-plugin.name: WP Review Gate
idea-plugin.description:
The readme.txt and plugin-header lines that send a wordpress.org submission back, found before you submit

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → WP Review Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 21 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/wp-plugin-review-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/wp-plugin-review-gate

action.text: WP Review Gate: Check This File
action.description: Run WP Review Gate on the file in the editor
